items.raw_excerpt: FAI Director of Football John Martin has revealed there was no consultation with goalkeepers within the Republic of Ireland squad prior to squad selection for the Israel games.

items.raw_excerpt: During its deliberations about the new package of agreements between Switzerland and the European Union, deputies decided that EU students enrolled at the Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology must receive the same treatment as Swiss students regarding tuition fees.
items.summary_en: Swiss lawmakers have approved equal tuition fees for EU students at two major Swiss universities. From now on, these students will pay the same fees as Swiss students. The decision came during talks on new agreements between Switzerland and the European Union.
items.summary_ko: 스위스 의회가 유럽연합 학생들이 스위스 연방 공과대학 두 곳에서 스위스 학생과 같은 등록금을 내도록 하는 안을 승인했다. 이제 이 학생들은 스위스 학생과 동일한 등록금을 낸다. 이번 결정은 스위스와 유럽연합 간 새로운 협정 논의 과정에서 나왔다.

items.raw_excerpt: An investigation into Dutch media coverage of weight loss drugs that led to several outlets being fined for breaching advertising laws was prompted by a complaint from a rival manufacturer, NRC reports. Newspapers including NRC, the Telegraaf, the Volkskrant and AD were sanctioned by the health inspectorate IGJ in August, when it ruled that articles about medicines such as Ozempic, Wegovy and Mounjaro were too positive. NRC said its lawyers had discovered that the IGJ acted after being asked to.
items.summary_en: Dutch newspapers were fined for articles about weight loss drugs such as Ozempic. The health inspectorate acted after a rival maker complained that the coverage was too positive.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 신문들이 오젬픽 등 체중 감량 약물에 관한 기사로 벌금을 물었다. 보건감독기관은 경쟁 제약사가 기사가 지나치게 긍정적이라고 항의한 뒤 제재에 나섰다.
items.title_en: Rival complaint triggered fines for Dutch drug articles
items.title_ko: 경쟁사 항의로 네덜란드 신문, 다이어트약 기사에 벌금
